title: Deleting and deactivating treasuries and what a transfer allows: a treasury nothing happened in can be deleted, one that moved money cannot even at a zero balance, an empty one can be deactivated and activated again; a transfer is edited in place in the reference system and only cancelled by a reversal here

delete_rules.note: A cash treasury with no movement deleted with its account; a bank account with two transfers and a balance of 0.00 refused with a message that it holds current movements and can be made inactive; so is a cash treasury with transfers only

deactivation.note: A treasury at a zero balance deactivated and activated again: the transfer button disappears while it is inactive and returns when it is active

transfers.note: Transfers of 100 between the treasury and the bank: journal 000165 debits the bank and credits the treasury, 000166 the opposite; the transfer page has no delete button and editing the amount edits the journal in place

inputs.treasury: two transfers in opposite directions, balance 0.00

cases.reason: The reference system gives a transfer no delete button and edits its amount in the same journal. Here a transfer is never edited: it is cancelled with a reason, which reverses its journal and keeps both, and another transfer is made (E15).

inputs.transfer: 100.00 from the treasury to the bank
